theorems.name: Submission.imsupp_orient_apply_ae_eq_zero_of_vanishesOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ W → R.orient x α = 0
